download_tav2_wb: download the TartanAirV2 wide baseline dataset from Hugging Face to a specified root directory
strip_terms_from_string: remove a list of terms from a string using regex pattern matching
TartanAirV2WideBaseline_init: initialize the TartanAirV2WideBaseline dataset class with a root directory and train val or test split
TartanAirV2WideBaseline_getitem: retrieve a pair of views with images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics by pair index
extract_h5_data: extract images, depth, camera params, and poses from h5 files to an output directory using parallel workers
